records.title: feat(lsp): make workspace-folder transitions delta-driven and epoch-safe
records.release_claim: workspace-root authority cannot be overwritten by stale folder-query responses
records.reason: Multi-root and root-transition safety are part of the editor reliability boundary.
records.non_claim: Does not prove packaged VS Code integration by itself.

records.title: feat(lsp): replace hidden stderr degradation with typed snapshot limitations
records.release_claim: component degradation is visible, typed, snapshot-bound, and consumed consistently
records.reason: Hidden stderr failures undermine the release claim of honest editor currentness and recovery.
records.non_claim: Typed limitation does not make incomplete findings complete.

records.title: protocol(lsp): add one typed ClientFeatureProfile as the initialize-capability authority
records.release_claim: one immutable negotiated profile owns client capability decisions for the session
records.reason: Scattered capability reads can otherwise produce contradictory push, pull, action, and refresh behavior.
records.non_claim: Reserved experimental features remain unsupported until their handlers land.

records.title: docs(spec-0081): document the client_features key in receipt-status packets
records.release_claim: receipt-status examples and producer mapping match the selected client-feature payload
records.reason: Included wire behavior requires matching retained protocol documentation and traceability.
records.non_claim: Documentation does not promote the experimental editor tier.

records.title: feat(lsp): versioned code-action data contract and closed disabled reasons
records.release_claim: repair actions carry versioned identity and fail-closed availability reasons
records.reason: Action currentness and authority cannot depend on title text or untyped payloads.
records.non_claim: Does not add automatic source edits or lazy repair computation.

records.title: feat(lsp): advertise codeAction/resolve as fail-closed revalidation
records.release_claim: resolved actions are revalidated against current snapshot, artifact, and capability authority
records.reason: Resolve-time staleness must disable or reject rather than silently execute old routes.
records.non_claim: Does not add new edit authority or command execution.

records.title: feat(lsp): quarantine dirty-buffer diagnostics until save
records.release_claim: saved-workspace evidence is never presented as current against unsaved text
records.reason: Dirty-buffer quarantine is a core currentness and line-identity guarantee.
records.non_claim: RIPR does not analyze unsaved buffer text.

records.title: fix(lsp): scope line-local diagnostics to production Rust anchors
records.release_claim: line-local editor findings obey the same production-source scope as other review surfaces
records.reason: Out-of-scope test/example diagnostics are an inverted-signal correctness defect.
records.non_claim: Other language adapters retain their documented scope ownership.

records.title: fix(vscode): probe the PATH fallback through the shell on win32
records.release_claim: the packaged extension can resolve supported Windows command shims from PATH
records.reason: Without PATHEXT-aware probing, valid Windows installations are reported missing.
records.non_claim: User-controlled text is not passed to the shell.

records.title: ux(vscode): apply ripr.trace.server changes live instead of restarting
records.release_claim: trace-level changes do not require dropping diagnostics and rerunning analysis
records.reason: Useful UX, but deferrable if the selected release documents restart behavior honestly.
records.non_claim: Deferral must not break trace configuration correctness.

records.title: test(lsp): framed saved-workspace end-to-end session fixture
records.release_claim: the saved-workspace lifecycle works as one real framed session
records.reason: This is load-bearing evidence for dirty/current/save/refresh/hover/shutdown parity.
records.non_claim: Does not prove every third-party client or packaged installation.

records.title: docs(spec): ratify RIPR-SPEC-0129 editor integration contract
records.release_claim: the selected editor contract is accepted only for its evidence-backed bounded surfaces
records.reason: The retained spec and support non-claims must travel with the included implementation group.
records.non_claim: Acceptance is not support-tier promotion or packaged install proof.

records.title: feat(lsp): commit limited snapshot with one warning diagnostic on oversized diffs
records.release_claim: oversized diff scope produces one visible limited result rather than a silent dropped refresh
records.reason: The editor must not turn a hard analysis guard into apparent cleanliness or silence.
records.non_claim: The limited snapshot contains no trustworthy complete finding set.

records.title: test(lsp): compatibility-command journey and receipt over the real stdio wire
records.release_claim: the public compatibility command journey operates over the real LSP wire
records.reason: Contract fixtures alone do not prove the binary-spawning protocol path.
records.non_claim: The journey receipt is protocol evidence, not RepairReceiptV2.

records.title: feat(lsp): cooperative git invocation timeout in the refresh path
records.release_claim: a stalled Git invocation cannot wedge the editor refresh queue indefinitely
records.reason: The current editor reliability headline requires bounded external-process waits and typed limited outcomes.
records.non_claim: CLI Git operations keep their separately documented behavior.

records.title: feat(lsp): physical refresh deadline with named DeadlineExceeded outcome
records.release_claim: accepted analysis work has a physical deadline and one named terminal outcome
records.reason: A cooperative but unbounded refresh can still pin the product indefinitely.
records.non_claim: Deadline expiry does not produce a complete or clean analysis snapshot.
